subject: gk
question: As per Consumer Protection Rules, 2021, District Commissions shall have jurisdiction to entertain complaints where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration ______.

options.text: does not exceed ten lakh rupees
does not exceed fifty lakh rupees
does not exceed one lakh rupees

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **On December 30, 2021**, the Central Government notified Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission, and the National Commission) Rules, 2021.</st
